guide_solution: (a) We work hard so that we can prosper in life. (b) If we are not industrious, we are sure to lag behind. (c) A man who leads an idle life can never prosper in life. (d) An idle man can never help people and so he cannot serve the society. (e) We know the proverb that "An idle brain is the devil's workshop".
